text: Happy birthday, my love 🎂💕 Sending you all the hugs, health, and happiness your heart can hold. 🤗
I still remember how nervous and excited I felt talking to you for the first time 🦋 — that feeling still hasn't faded.
Every new thing I learn about you makes me like you even more 😊, and I still feel like there's so much left to discover.
It's strange how quickly you started to feel familiar 🥹. I got so comfortable with you, so soon — like I'd always known you.
Every call, every text, every 'good morning' ☀️ and 'good night' 🌙 from miles away is bringing us closer to the day we won't have to wait anymore.
I don't know everything about long distance, but I know this — waiting for you is worth it, every single time. 🕰️💗
You're so special and so important to me 🥰. I'm truly grateful to have you in my life.
Once again, happy birthday, love 🎉🎈 Take care, and I miss you so much already. 🥺💖
